subject: Your OpenMentor profile has been deleted
html:
Your profile has been deleted
Profile deleted
Hi {{first_name}} — your OpenMentor profile has been deleted. It is no longer listed in the catalog, its page is gone, and you can no longer sign in.
What happens to your data
Your profile will be permanently erased, along with the mentee requests and reviews attached to it. Any review invitations still with your mentees have already been cancelled.
Didn't expect this? Reply to this email as soon as possible and we can restore your profile. Once it has been erased it cannot be undone.
Questions? Just reply to this email. · openmentor.io

Hi {{first_name}},

Your OpenMentor profile has been deleted. It is no longer listed in the catalog, its page is gone, and you can no longer sign in.

WHAT HAPPENS TO YOUR DATA
Your profile will be permanently erased, along with the mentee requests and reviews attached to it. Any review invitations still with your mentees have already been cancelled.

Didn't expect this? Reply to this email as soon as possible and we can restore your profile. Once it has been erased it cannot be undone.
